notes.title: Sclender 1.8.5
notes.content:
- Sclender works better with various display settings and the Launcher window is larger
- Compatibility hacks for when you don't want to dig into an app's settings to get it to work with Sclender (beware the software rendering/reference rasterizer setting...)
- Tooltips (hints that appear when mouse moves over a widget) are a little easier to follow

notes.title: Sclender 1.8.3
notes.content:
- Full screen output automatically repositions the target application to the upper left corner of the screen
- Output positioning for offset mode fixed
- Dejag HQ filter has been improved

notes.title: Sclender 1.8 Released
notes.content:
If multiple GPUs are installed/active they can be selected from the Config Tab. By such means you can dedicate one GPU to Sclender and another to your game.
You can now select how many processors/cores you use at a time for filtering. Look under the Config Tab.
New filters released: ordered dither scaling, TV color filters and adjustments, vignette filter, posterization/bit depth reduction.

notes.title: Sclender 1.7.3 Update
notes.content: Bug fixes; Sclender buttons now have more helpful tooltips.

notes.title: Sclender 1.6.5 released
notes.content:
New Features

 User can now manually override Sclender's title bar detection. This is important because bugs happen when Sclender thinks there is a title bar but there isn't one. To see these bugs for yourself, try Sclender with your browser's pop-out-video on Youtube or Twitch and compare with the override on vs off. (be sure to turn off the browser's hardware acceleration first! See wiki, under Support, for details.)

The override switch is located on the Render Config panel, under "Capture".

 Sclender will now use half of the cores on your system for CPU-based rendering (or 1 if there is only 1 core)
 If Sclender fails to attach successfully to an app, the user will be notified (try it with the new Windows Calculator)

notes.title: Sclender 1.6.4
notes.content:
Features

Bilinear post-filtering makes irregularly scaled images look better

Bloom filter is now multi-threaded

Fixes

 the rendering is a little cleaner
 Sclender is a bit faster

notes.title: Sclender Lite 1.6.4
notes.content:
Added bilinear option
BlurLeft and BlurLeftStrong fixed; algorithms for Perceptual Scanlines and Medium Blur changed. All known non-mouse related bugs fixed
 Sclender runs slightly faster

notes.title: Important Update!
notes.content:
Fixes to rendering (checks window for title bar is presence, adjusts output accordingly)
All buttons now show hand pointer instead of arrow pointer on hover
Sclender Lite updates in-line with Gamers Gold edition (filter fixes and others)

notes.title: Sclender 1.6 released
notes.content:
Added GPU filters:

 PC98-style CRT
 S-Video-style CRT
 CRT Scanlines
 LCD
 GBA Scanlines
 Blur Left Strong


Fixed Dejag (GPU)


The GPU filters are substantially faster than the CPU filters and should perform well even on low-end machines. Enjoy!


Focus for next version: Dejag family GPU filters

notes.title: Sclender Gamers Gold released
notes.content:
The full version of Sclender provides better performance and more options than Sclender Lite, especially for streamers.

* Frame rates up to 144fps (depending on hardware capabilities) 
* Support for up to 4 cores for CPU-based filters
* The ability to position output at precise coordinates and to continue showing it when target apps are inactive
* Render manager enables oversight of all running filters and provides helpful information to interface your filters with streaming video apps
* Sclender auto-attach service begins filtering your apps as soon as you launch them

Sclender Gamers Gold retails for $24.99


All users of Sclender are invited to the Sclender Facebook group at https://www.facebook.com/Sclenderapp where you can get in-person support for using Sclender and developing filter projects, and we will also support you over the official Sclender Steam forum.
